title: fix(metadata-core): the artifact forward conversion walks every packages[].manifest body of an option-B artifact (ADR-0130 D4)
body:
Part of #23027
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`applyArtifactForwardConversions` (`packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts`) ran the ADR-0087 conversion over the definition's own collections only. A multi-package artifact (ADR-0130 D4, option B) carries its collections in `packages[i].manifest`, and the strict parse gates each body, so a retired key inside a body refused the artifact while the same key at the top level was converted.

Now ONE walk runs over every root the definition carries: the definition first, then each `packages[i].manifest` body. It is the same `applyConversions` call, with the same registry, the same `includeRetired` and the same `excludeConversionIds`, under the one window decided above. There is no second walk and no entry list of its own (the triage direction). Copy-on-write holds at both levels. A `packages` that is not an array, and an entry or body that is not an object, come back exactly as given: this never gates, and `resolveArtifactPackageOrder` stays the refusal. A body's notices are located from the definition's root. Their `path` and the one place `message` quotes it read `packages[1].manifest.dashboards[0].refreshIntervalSeconds`, so the metadata door's boot warning names the body. No exported member is added or changed (`Clause-②: no`, as claimed).

## Which window governs a body: the artifact's, measured, not a contract question

Measured on `os build` of `examples/app-multi-package`: the artifact's own `manifest` is its LAST package's manifest (`composeStacks`'s `'last'` pick), and each body carries its own manifest fields, `engines.protocol: '^18'` included. The window is decided once from the artifact's own `engines.protocol`, and a body's own `engines.protocol` is not read. Why:

- The floor stands in for when the artifact was built (module doc). One `os build` serializes every body of one artifact together (ADR-0130 D1: one atomic delivery).
- The artifact-boot handshake reads the same thing: `AppPlugin.init` and `assertArtifactProtocolCompatible` judge the artifact's own `manifest`.
- An artifact built before the D4 addendum carries the same definition twice, at the top level and in a body. A per-body window would turn those two copies into two answers.

Both directions are pinned. An artifact at `^18` whose bodies declare a floor that no window opens for still converts its bodies. An artifact past every retirement whose bodies declare no range converts nothing.

## Measured at the public door: what this PR does NOT yet deliver

On BASE `0ede0f8ab3`, `os dev -a optionb.json --fresh` (two-package `os build` output, with `refreshInterval: 300` injected into `packages[1].manifest.dashboards`) exits at boot, health `000`: "`packages[1]` is not a package entry (ADR-0130 D4): manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval: `dashboard.refreshInterval` was renamed…".

After this PR, at `ec37c88413`, which includes the landed #23024 (`AppPlugin`'s converted copy), the same door exits identically. The refusal does not come from the metadata door. In-process, `createDefaultHostConfig` throws `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` / `422` from this stack:

```text
resolveArtifactPackageOrder   (core dist)
resolveArtifactCollections    (runtime dist)
createStandaloneStack         (runtime dist, standalone-stack.ts, the `artifactStack` read)
```

`@objectstack/runtime` reads the RAW bundle in several places before any conversion: `createStandaloneStack`, `mergeRuntimeModule` in `loadArtifactBundle`, `AppPlugin`'s `collections` getter, and the `packages[]` branch of `AppPlugin.init`, which hands the bundle to `manifest.register` as authored. Every one of them parses each body strictly.

Control probe: I wrote the artifact back exactly as `applyArtifactForwardConversions` now answers it, that is, what those readers would see if the bundle were converted once at load. That file boots on the same door, health `200`. `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/crm_overview` serves `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `_diagnostics.valid: true`, `_packageId: com.example.multi.core`. `crm_orders_overview` serves `120` under `com.example.multi.orders`. The list serves both as valid. So this PR's output is what boots, and the missing piece is a runtime seam that converts the loaded bundle once before its readers run. That seam is outside this claim's file surface, so this PR carries `Part of`, not a closing keyword. The report names the remaining half.

Definition-collection control at the same door, at `ec37c88413`: a single-manifest artifact with a top-level `refreshInterval: 300` dashboard boots, health `200`. Both the item read and the list serve `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `valid: true`. This diff does not change that path.

## Config boot (`composeStacks`) of the same shape, measured

`os dev` on a config `composeStacks([orders, core], { manifest: 'preserve' })` whose `core` dashboard spells `refreshInterval` exits before the server starts, with `defineStack validation failed: dashboards.0.refreshInterval: … renamed to refreshIntervalSeconds … Run os migrate meta --from 17`. `composeStacks` composes only `defineStack`-built inputs (`STACK_PROVENANCE_MISSING` otherwise), and `defineStack` is the authoring funnel, which never replays a retired entry. A live author is taught the tombstone, which is ADR-0087's posture. No fix is needed there.

## Tests, at `ec37c88413`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test`: 18 files, 681 tests passed. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `-p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the new test file in the test program.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 60 files, 879 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0, and the new test file is in its program.
- New `artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts` (metadata-core, 142 tests). Premise: unconverted, both the definition parse and the `ArtifactPackageSchema` entry gate refuse the body. Pin 1 covers the undeclared, `^18`-on-17.7.0 and `^18`-on-18.0.1 windows. The body converts to `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, the notice names `packages[1].manifest…` in `path` and `message`, both gates admit the result, and untouched bodies keep their references. Pin 2: multi-package, per body, by the whole chain (a dashboard and a declared index in one body), and a clean body by reference. Pin 3, the control: a definition without `packages[]` gives exactly the primitive's notices, paths and messages. The same definition at the top level and in a body converts to one answer. Window shut: an `authored-current` body is unchanged and refused. Per-entry window: a body replays the 17.5.0 cohort and keeps the 17.3.0 rename for its tombstone. Window authority, both directions. Never gates. The whole of step 18 over a package body: all 66 retired entries, both directions, with the default flip never replayed.
- New `plugin-artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts` (metadata, the real `_parseAndRegisterArtifact`, installed label). It boots, the dashboard registers as `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300` owned by its package, and it converts per body. One summary line reads `2 site(s)` and `first at packages[0].manifest.dashboards[0].refreshIntervalSeconds`. The same artifact built after the rename logs nothing. Window shut: the tombstone still refuses at `packages.1.manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval`.
- In-process reproduction on BASE metadata-core dist (before the rebuild): the door test was 3 red with `invalid_type` / "`dashboard.refreshInterval` was renamed" and 2 green (the two controls).

## Ablation: drop the package-body root, then restore

Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode). The call `replayPackageBodies(replay(definition, ''), replay)` becomes `replay(definition, '')`, with the reference kept so the build type-checks.

- Leg 1, metadata-core (source-resolved). Predicted: every body pin red, the controls and the whole existing suite green. Observed: anchor x1 → x0, blob `1ac3ee48d273` → `b99253ed7ec9`. 72 failed and 252 passed out of 324: the 7 body pins plus 65 step-18 "built before" legs (66 minus the flip). The premise, the definition-collection control, window-shut, never-gates, the flip, all 66 "built after" legs and all of `artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` stayed green. Restore: blob == HEAD (`1ac3ee48d273`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg 2, the metadata door (it resolves `@objectstack/metadata-core` through `dist/`). Mutate, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build`, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/metadata-core ablatedBodies`: hits in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. Door suites: 3 failed and 27 passed out of 30. Boots, per-body and log went red; the current and window-shut controls and the four existing door files stayed green. Restore proven (blob == HEAD, diff empty), then a rebuild. `--absent` passed: "marker absent from all 12 built files", "working tree clean against HEAD". The door file is back to 5/5.

## Gates, at `ec37c88413`

The lead list (64) plus `dispatch-gates --commands` on this diff (63, the lead list minus `check:stack-collection-maps`, which was run anyway): 64 of 64 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) on its first run. Its rerun, with every dist present, exited 0: "107 published require entry point(s) across 66 package(s) load". `dispatch-gates --ran`: "63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

Lint, narrowed to the 3 touched TS files, with three proofs. Population: `eslint --print-config` gives 6/5/5 rules in effect, so none of the files is ignored. Count: `--format json` reports 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Invariance: every `parserOptions` in `eslint.config.mjs` is `{ ecmaVersion, sourceType }` with no `project`, so there is no type-aware linting and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. `pnpm lint` is CI's to run.

## Acceptance notes

- `detectUnboundFormViewPredicateRoots` (`form-predicate-root-policy.ts`) reads only the definition's own `views`, so the metadata door's bare-root form-predicate notice does not see an option-B body's views. This is the same reach family. I read it but did not measure it at a door, and this PR does not change it.
- The comment on `AppPlugin.init`'s `packages[]` branch (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`, the servicePayload block) says package bodies are what "no conversion reaches". After this PR that is false for the conversion itself. The runtime seam that completes #23027 is where the sentence changes.
- Changeset `.changeset/23027-package-body-conversion.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata-core`. It names the default-host refusal under "Not yet", so the CHANGELOG does not claim the `os dev -a` boot.
